summary: Restore the nullish-coalescing operator in retryCount so a caller-supplied 0 is honoured instead of falling through to the default.

steps.step: In src/retry.ts change `maxRetries || DEFAULT_RETRIES` back to `maxRetries ?? DEFAULT_RETRIES`, so only undefined selects the default.
Add a regression test covering the zero case beside the existing tests.
steps.acceptance: the new test fails against the current code and passes after the change

contracts.rule:
A caller-supplied retry count is honoured exactly, including zero, which means
  "do not retry".
